import sys

def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    ans = 0
    col = [False] * n
    diag1 = [False] * (2 * n - 1)
    diag2 = [False] * (2 * n - 1)

    def solve(r):
        nonlocal ans
        if r == n:
            ans += 1
            return
        for c in range(n):
            if col[c] or diag1[r + c] or diag2[r - c + n - 1]:
                continue
            col[c] = diag1[r + c] = diag2[r - c + n - 1] = True
            solve(r + 1)
            col[c] = diag1[r + c] = diag2[r - c + n - 1] = False

    solve(0)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
